_readme: Values for the approved architecture. Written AFTER the analyst gate, with
financial-model-assumptions supplying the evidence and confidence for each
driver — this file is where those agreed values are collected so the segment
years[0] is the BASE year, then one entry per forecast year. Every driver
series starts at the base year, because the build has to reproduce the year it
can see before it forecasts years it cannot. segment_build.py checks that
reconstruction against base_revenue and REFUSES on a mismatch above 1%.
A driver value may be a scalar (held flat) or a list, one entry per year in
years. Short lists are held flat at the last value and reported.
Rates (utilisation, execution_rate, churn, occupancy, ...) may be given as 38
unit_scale converts the driver product into INR cr. Leave it null to have the
base year calibrate it; the implied scale is reported and flagged when it is
not a clean power of ten, because that means the drivers do not explain the

evidence.quote: unexecuted order book of INR 12,480 cr
order inflow of INR 5,900 cr during the year
orders typically execute over 30 to 36 months

unallocated._comment: Optional. Inter-segment eliminations or unallocated revenue, per year, in INR cr. Same length as years.
